title: ToolInvocation
description: Internal shape for invoking a tool (07_tools) or MCP-exposed function (11_mcp/tools).

tool.description: Dotted identifier resolving to a callable. e.g. 'tools.embeddings.query.LocalKnowledgeQuery.query' or 'mcp_servers.tools.local_tools.run_local_tests'.

arguments.description: Keyword arguments. The tool's own signature is the source of truth for valid keys.

timeout_sec.description: Optional override of the tool's default timeout.

call_id.description: Optional caller-provided identifier for correlating with stream events.
